Value-added based indexes; '_qa' on the quality-adjusted hours basis, '_hours' on the hours-worked basis. Income shares (Table 14) are the labour and capital shares of value added used for value-added MFP; cost shares (Table 19) are shares of gross output, unsmoothed, used for gross-output MFP (may end a year earlier). null = not available.
